read: Known only as the second half of HUL's D2C acquisition pair: india_findings.yaml records 'HUL acquired Minimalist (~Rs3,000cr) and Plum', and companies.yaml carries it as acquired with acquirer 'Unilever (reported)'. No consideration, revenue, margin or segment split has been collected, so the transaction is evidenced as a fact but not as a price — only the Minimalist multiple is available as a reference. Profiled here because the move matters to the consolidation read even though the figures do not yet exist; it is a candidate for the next research pass alongside the other undated strategic deals.
